draft.subject: Following up on your open tickets
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for flagging both issues — the random logouts and the Slack integration page that keeps spinning. Both tickets are open with our team, and I'm keeping an eye on them with you.

I know losing typed work is frustrating, and I don't want it to stall your first week. You've already got a project created in Wrenfield, which is the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through your next step and make sure nothing's blocked on our side.

Best,
Nadia
